6.302 Problem Set 3
Problem 1. Use the Routh-Hurwitz criterion to decide the stability of the system with characteristic polynomial s^4 + 2 s^3 + 3 s^2 + 4 s + 5 and count the roots in the right half plane. (10 points)
Problem 2. Sketch the Bode plot of a lead compensator and state the phase margin gained at the crossover frequency of the loop. (5 points)
